description: Maheshwari Logistics Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in coal, petcoke, wastepaper, and lignite trading business in India. It operates through three segments: Trading, Transport & Port Service, and Manufacturing Kraft Paper. The company is involved in the business of selling and servicing of heavy vehicle and manufacturing of printed mono carton packaging and corrugated boxes; transportation and port services; diesel, and industrial fuels; and manufactures recycled kraft paper. It also provides road logistics, bulk cargo transport, and fleet operations; Mahindra commercial vehicle sales, servicing, and spare parts; supplying non-cooking coal; and trading and exports of various papers; and engages in commercial vehicle dealership operations. In addition, the company operates through a network of offices, kraft paper plant, and coal screening facility. Maheshwari Logistics Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vapi, India.
